name: 07302 · Jersey City, NJ
findings: ZIP 07302 (Jersey City) has 203 nonprofit organizations. 89 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07302 (Jersey City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
